name: Payhawk
summary: Payhawk sells expenses as the Cards & Expenses module, starting at $449 a month on its US pricing page. Unlimited employee seats and approval workflows are included, and the final price depends on plan, add-ons, cards and transaction volume.

facts.text: Approval flows can be defined per expense type and routed by amount, supplier, category or team.
Payouts can go to employees' personal bank accounts through payroll integration or direct bank transfer.
Payhawk says the price depends on plans, add-ons, admin and accountant seats, cards and transaction volume, with no implementation fee.
Its security page names ISO 27001 and SOC 1 and 2 compliance for its cloud providers, not for Payhawk itself.

plans.name: Cards & Expenses
plans.notes: Starting price on the US page; unlimited employee seats. Final cost depends on add-ons, cards and volume

hiddenCosts: Credit line, budget tracking, native ERP integrations and extra entities are add-ons with no published price.
